title: The Last Rites
logline: A dying soldier stranded in a dead system asks a pilot to recover their fallen squad's dog tags, but their former commander wants them destroyed.

roles.description: Bleeding out, calm, focused entirely on their final mission.
Cold, calculating, sees soldiers merely as assets.
A massive debris field of shattered military ships.
A stealth corvette sent to clean up loose ends.
The bureaucratic heart of the military apparatus.

public_situation: The {role:naval_command} has officially declared the entire squad lost with all hands, classifying the {role:battlefield_wreckage} as a restricted zone.
private_truth: The commander deliberately sacrificed the squad to cover a tactical blunder. The soldier survived just long enough to record the truth on their dog tags.

beats.public_change: The commander issues a system-wide order forbidding any salvage in the wreckage.

missions.reason: The soldier asks the pilot to deliver ferrite to patch their life support just long enough to finish the mission.
missions.private_fact: The soldier is too badly injured; the patch will only buy them a few hours.

beats.public_change: A stealth gunship arrives in the system to ensure there are no survivors.

missions.reason: The commander hires the pilot to scan the wreckage to "confirm the casualties".
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the gunship is actively firing on escape pods.

beats.public_change: The gunship closes in on the soldier's final position.

missions.reason: The soldier begs the pilot to destroy the gunship and recover the real combat logs from its wreckage to prove the truth.
missions.private_fact: The commander hails the pilot, ordering them to let the gunship finish its work or face a court-martial.

player_choice.prompt: The gunship is destroyed, and the pilot holds the combat logs. The commander demands they be erased.

options.label: Publish the logs to avenge the squad
Erase the logs and walk away

resolutions.summary: The logs expose the commander's treason. The commander is court-martialed, and the soldier dies knowing their squad is honored.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a corrupt commander to honor the dying wish of a stranded soldier.

resolutions.summary: The truth is buried. The soldier dies in despair, and the commander receives a medal for the "tragic" loss of the squad.
The gunship obliterates the soldier's position. The truth is lost forever.

loose_threads.detail: The commander sacrificed the squad because they were paid off by a rival megacorp.
The stealth gunship wasn't navy issue; it belonged to a completely off-the-books intelligence agency.

radio_hooks: Tragic loss of military squad reported in dead system.

voice_direction.dying_soldier: Weak, raspy, but speaks with absolute resolve.
voice_direction.ruthless_commander: Brisk, entirely unemotional, treats lives like math.
